summary: 봄 이동기에 서해 섬에서 해마다 드물게 관찰되는 나그네새로, 국내에서는 2003년 5월 소청도에서 처음 기록되었다. 기록은 대부분 4~5월 소청도·어청도·홍도·외연도 같은 서해 섬에서 나왔고, 2023년 2월에는 제주에서 겨울을 나던 개체도 관찰되었다. 중국 중부의 산지 숲에서 베이징 부근까지 번식하는 중국 고유에 가까운 새로, 중국 밖 기록은 드물다.

art.subject: Chinese Thrush (Turdus mupinensis), adult (sexes alike), as seen in Korea on spring migration: crown, upperparts and tail plain olive-brown; face whitish-buff with bold black markings: a black bar below and behind the eye, a black crescent at the rear of the ear-coverts and a black malar stripe; two whitish-buff wing-bars on the median and greater coverts; underparts white, washed buff on the breast, boldly marked with large rounded black spots on the breast, flanks and upper belly. Bill dark with a yellowish base to the lower mandible; dark eye; legs pale pinkish-brown.
art.pose: standing upright on leaf litter under trees, side view
art.scene: forest floor with leaf litter and young shrubs on a Korean offshore island during spring migration in May; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing upright on leaf litter: plain mid-brown crown, upperparts and tail, greyish face with a bold black crescent behind the ear coverts and a dark malar stripe, whitish throat, two white wing-bars on the median and greater coverts, buff-washed breast and white belly with large bold dark spots reaching the vent, pale legs

adult, front view standing upright: greyish face with black crescents behind the ear coverts, whitish throat bordered by dark malar stripes, buff-washed breast and flanks with large rounded dark spots, white belly spotted to the vent
art.build: Medium thrush, about the size of a Pale Thrush and a little smaller than a Dusky Thrush; plump-bodied and upright with a rounded head. Bill straight, shorter than the head. Legs fairly long, pale. Wings marked with two pale bars on the coverts; tail medium length, square-ended and plain. Hops on the forest floor, turning leaves and standing tall between hops.
avoid: Do not paint golden-buff scaly crescents on the upperparts; that is White's Thrush (Zoothera aurea).
Do not leave the wing plain; it has two clear pale wing-bars.
Do not paint rufous on the flanks or tail.
Do not turn the black spots into streaks; they are large and rounded.

동정 포인트와 도해 모습은 국립생물자원관 원문에 생김새 설명이 없어 국내외 종 설명 두 곳 이상과 참고 사진으로 교차 확인해 썼다(출처 목록)
암수 구별: 홍콩조류학회·Hartert(1910)·Shanghai Birding 모두 암수를 나누지 않고 한 가지 깃만 기재해 암수가 같은 것으로 보이나, 이를 밝힌 자료를 찾지 못했다
어린새: Hartert(1910)가 Pleske를 인용한 어린 깃 설명(머리꼭대기·등·어깨깃에 황갈색 깃대 반점, 배의 반점이 잚)과 홍콩조류학회의 첫겨울깃 설명(날개덮깃 끝의 흰 반점이 넓음)이 서로 다른 시기를 다뤄 교차 확인이 되지 않았다
